summary: Rudio Mountain lookout in Grant County, OR: 106-foot wooden tower built 1936, staffed by 1947, now gone with no public access; removal undated.

facts.design: 106-foot wooden tower with 7x7-foot cab and a cabin
facts.status_note: Register says the tower and cabin are now gone; Forest Lookouts lists the tower as removed with no date

access.note: firelookout.com lists no public access to the site; no source describes the site today

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register, firelookout.com and the Forest Lookouts header name the Oregon Dept. of Forestry; a 1942 Coast and Geodetic Survey description calls the tower a U.S. Forest Service lookout. Both are recorded; neither is chosen.

notes_for_editor: Good annual notes on the Forest Lookouts page (1938-1968) but the removal is undated and no source describes the site today. The 1942 survey description says U.S.F.S. while the register, firelookout.com and the Forest Lookouts header say ODF (reported in the story). The register phrase 'used for emergency in the 1960s' is unclear and is quoted rather than interpreted. The LandWatch listing returned 403 and was not used. No photos added.
